12-hours-after:
A very ordinary white collar worker, Han Sang Hoon.
One day, he came late to work and there he finds a strange destiny called [12 Hours After]
a-favor-done-a-husband-won:
[Cute Baby • Sweet & Satisfying • Contract Signed]
A missing billionaire lands—half-dead—on her couch.
Five years earlier she crawled out of a fire her own blood set. Now she’s back, four-year-old sidekick in tow, to save the stranger she found on her doorstep.
He looks harmless, eats her snacks, then—snap!—shreds the white-lotus neighbor, gifts hugs, kisses, and a life that suddenly runs on easy mode.
Wait a minute, why are those people respectfully calling him CEO…?!
a-practical-guide-to-sorcery:
In a world where magic is a science, Siobhan is a genius.
But even geniuses need schooling.
When Siobhan stumbled into the theft of a priceless magical book, she thought her dreams of becoming the world's most powerful sorcerer were destroyed.
But then a mysterious spell changed her life forever...
Siobhan is now wearing the body of a strange man and has a new identity—Sebastien. With a new chance for a new start, she allies herself with a local gang—secretly a revolutionary party funding itself through crime. Now, she is bound by vow to repay them in magic and favors.
But as Sebastien's reputation begins to bloom, and Siobhan's old enemies still lurk in the shadows, she quickly realizes that the secrets of this world are deeper and darker than she ever could have imagined.
Forced to juggle the two sides of her double life, Siobhan is determined to uncover the truth and take control of the name they gave her - The Raven Queen.

Shen and Ming, two top wealthy families, have married.
As the object of marriage, Professor Ming is obsessed with scientific research, education, and psychological construction and can’t extricate himself. He really has no relationship with the big devil Shen Tinglan!
The two of them don’t even bother to play every scene, and Ming Qianye thinks about being annulled by the Great Demon King all the time!

Laverne never believed in the supernatural. To him, life was already complicated enough without worrying about things like ghosts or reincarnation. But when a reckless act of bravery ends in fire and chaos, he wakes up to something far worse than death—an unfamiliar world governed by an unfathomable system.
Marked as an Anomaly, an existence that shouldn't be, he finds himself entangled in forces beyond mortal comprehension. The world he is reborn into runs on the concept of Ka, the essence of life and fate itself. Yet, unlike others, his Ka does not conform—it rebels. The system that governs this world struggles to define him, its very framework warping around his presence.
With each step forward, he realizes that his mere existence is enough to tip the scales of destiny. Some will seek to control him. Others will try to erase him. But one truth remains:
'In a world where fate reigns supreme, what happens when something stands outside of its design?'
as-the-novels-extra-villian-i-shall-stea:
Reincarnated into a web novel as Victor Vance a arrogant, doomed villain meant to be slain by the heroic protagonist he chooses a far more seductive path: total, unyielding dominion.
The realm worships Lucas, the saintly “Hero of Prophecy.” But behind his golden aura lies an arrogant hypocrite who uses women as disposable shields. Armed with the predatory Heroine Capture System and an intoxicating, dark mana, Victor targets the hero’s most prized companions offering them the dark, physical relief their bodies desperately crave:
Lady Lyra von Frostguard: The untouchable Ice Princess whose frozen exterior hides a torturous mana affliction cured only by Victor’s burning, possessive touch.
Aria: The lethal half-demon assassin bound to the hero in shame who finds breathless liberation and an addictive, dark surrender beneath Victor’s absolute leash.
While the false hero parades for public praise, Victor operates in the shadows, completing high-stakes system tasks, claiming hot, breathless heroines, and systematically stripping the hero of his achievements, his power, and his women.
Forget redemption.…
back-to-the-13th-century-with-an-ai-chip:
Stuck in the year 1204, with no way to get back to my time, I was plunged into a world vastly different from the one I knew.
I have a valuable asset in my possession - an AI chip implanted in my brain, loaded with thousands of engineering books.
battle-through-the-heavens-novel: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and the weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?
beast-world-a-fragile-beauty-blessed-wit:
Si Shuo didn't get a compatible heart in time, but instead received the More Children, More Blessings System and was sent to the Beast World Continent.
She is a mutated, blue-eyed, white-furred female Cat Beast with a congenital hearing impairment. Her fertility was even stripped away by her Mother and given to her older sister. She is now facing the crisis of not finding a mate and being sent to the female cave!
System: Congratulations, Host, for obtaining a special-grade fertile constitution that surpasses even a Female Saint... Congratulations, Host, for obtaining the life-infused Wood Element Ability... Congratulations, Host, for obtaining a shared growth space... Congratulations, Host, for obtaining the Nine Lives Cat destiny, which can be inherited by your offspring.
From then on, she began living a cozy life with a husband, children, and a warm home...
civil-servant-in-romance-fantasy:
I was reincarnated into the world of a novel I’d only read the free chapters.
Thankfully, the blood flowing in the body of the person I’d possessed was blue.
“The prominence of our family comes from the blessing bestowed upon us by the royal family throughout the generations.”
Maybe this is the price to pay for that. But I got a father who seems overly loyal to the Emperor. And because of that, I was forced to become a Civil Servant.
While everyone else enjoys romance, I’m just spending my days as a Civil Servant.
classroom-of-the-elite-year-2:
Author : Kinugasa Shougo
Illustrator : Tomoseshunsaku
As Ayanokouji and his classmates begin their second year at the Advanced Nurturing High School, they're greeted by a fresh gauntlet of exams and a fresh batch of rather unique first-year students. They'll have to get to know each other quickly, because the first special exam pairs the first-years with the second-years on a written test--with only the second-years facing expulsion if their team performs poorly! Worse yet? It seems one of the new first-years is also from the White Room. Can Ayanokouji avoid expulsion while sussing out the identity of this hidden foe?
constellation-door:
“Legend had it that in the deepest part of the oldest galaxy, there was a door as red as blood and fire.
Legends and myths, darkness and light, countless stories passed through this old door.
The Door of Constellation that overlooked everything would warn the sky and earth, sending darkness back to where it belonged.”
crime-prison-island:
After the nuclear war, the world was controlled by twenty mega-corporations that established a global government. Governed by AI, it judged everything.
Gao Xin, who had only wished to live a peaceful life, inexplicably became a scapegoat for the elite and, unable to pay the imprisonment fee, was sentenced to ten years of exile on Crime Prison Island!
On this island, there were no laws, no constraints, the only order being the numerous game arenas set up by the officials.
The criminals could only participate like racehorses for the entertainment of the elite.
Yet, on this prison island filled with Radiation, cyborgs, and many powerful villains, Gao Xin had no strength, no talent, and no background—like a sheep thrown into a crocodile pool, no different from being on death row.
How could an ordinary person like him survive under the oppression of the strong, the geniuses, and the wicked? Unless in this world, there was a path, a path that allowed even the weakest to continuously break their shackles.
deep-space-wandering-fleet:
Earth is the human civilization’s cradle, but humans cannot possibly live within its cradle for eternity.
In 2264, the first deep-space colonization spaceship of human civilization leaves the solar system and enters the boundless darkness…
Zhang Yuan, son of the man behind the spaceship’s main control system, is one of the half a million volunteers to embark on the 20 light-year journey to a new planet.
Follow Zhang Yuan on his journey of gaining new knowledge, exploring the unknown, and finding out what's the secret behind the intelligence enhancer his father left him.
femdom-island:
Nikol didn't think that his life would end on that day.
He was invited by his elder sister to go on a cruise vacation. Since it was a request from her he couldn't reject it.
During this vacation, Nikol fell from the boat and died protecting his sister from an attacker, at least that's what he thought but he felt something pulling him from the ocean giving him a nostalgic and warm feeling.
When he opened his eyes there was a figure, that he could easily identify but at the same time, she was quite different from what he remembered.
“My son, Welcome back”
It was the last thing, he heard before he lost consciousness again.
When Nikol opened his eyes again, he was amazed to see a dense forest around him filled with greenery.
At that time, he didn't know that this land was called Femdom Island for a reason.
Come and Join Nikol to find his fate, in this unknown land.
from-broken-to-beloved:
At a lavish party, she was betrayed by her own sister, losing everything—her innocence, her reputation, and her fiancé’s trust. He left her without a second thought, leaving her to bear the shame and heartbreak alone. She fled abroad, determined to start over. Two years later, a family emergency forces her back home, where she takes a job as a designer at a prestigious studio. Expecting life to be cruel once again, she is shocked when the man who once broke her heart returns—and this time, he showers her with a love deeper and more possessive than she ever imagined.
This is part of a series. The first two books are “You’re Just My Ex-Husband, My Lord” and “Dating the Bossy CEO Next Door.” Hope you enjoy them!
from-villain-to-virtual-sweetheart-the-f:
Oops! The foolish real young master had run away!!!
The title of the book…
Micah had everything anyone could possibly envy, a gentle mother, a supportive father, and two doting older sisters. His family business dominated the capital with its high-technology products, and he was raised with a silver spoon from birth. Life was perfect. Until one day everything crumbled when a young man appeared, claiming to be the real young master.
The classic case of swapped at birth…
Panicked and heartbroken, Micah, the fake heir, fought desperately to hold onto his family and fortune.
From Bad-mouthing and spreading rumours to initiating misplaced hatred toward the real young master, he plotted financial pitfalls and implicated his family business in progress. Not to mention his backstabbing and selling the classified information to a rival company.
“What the actual f..?”
Micah stared at the book, seething with anger.
He was practically a villain out of a melodrama.…

gangster-to-idol:
Cain was living his best life as the leader of CROSS, a gang ruling Zone A, District 4.
At 21, thanks to constant cigarettes and booze, he looked older than his years. He didn’t finish college or have a job, but he made a living through “guard fees” from local markets and his shady side business.
One night, his life turned upside down when a shooting star crashed through his window, transforming into a cute fairy girl in a pink dress and rabbit hat, who declared herself the Idol-Idol Goddess!
Now, Cain has to juggle being a gang leader and a rising idol star. Can he balance both lives without blowing his cover?

grinding-to-martial-emperor-from-the-bor:
Upon transmigrating, Lu Yuan was immediately abandoned by his clan, banished to the desolate frontier to take the fall for his cousin’s crimes.
Fortunately, he obtained a Proficiency System. As long as he was willing to train relentlessly, he could endlessly level up his martial arts and cultivation techniques, from the most basic entry-level martial arts to heaven-destroying, sea-filling divine skills…
Facing treacherous plots and deadly dangers from all factions, Lu Yuan shattered them all with absolute sheer force. Forging his own path through the chaos, he stood tall and eventually ascended to the absolute pinnacle of the world!
he-is-lovestruck-in-the-revenge:
The Xie Family all studied law, possessing the fine qualities expected of a scholarly family. Xie Shang too had them: elegance, deep learning, a Fragrance Connoisseur versed in classics, also skilled in zither, chess, calligraphy, and painting.
But he was mad, capable of reciting the scriptures while holding a Buddha statue, as well as breaking people's hand and foot bones, very gentle, yet very cruel.
Xie Shang didn't become a lawyer but opened a pawnshop instead, where you could pawn anything as long as the story was compelling.
One day, someone came to the pawnshop and told a story:
In Fragrant City, there was a family with the surname Wen, where daughters took their mother's surname. The daughters of that family could cast spells, the kind that bewitched men, leaving their lovers either buried with them or taking vows of celibacy; in short, either dead or destined for a lonely life.
Xie Shang's uncle had died in Fragrant City, which is why he accepted this particular pawning business.
Bewitched, confused, thrilled, deeply in love, but love unattained, and a pain so intense it made life unbearable. — This was the script Xie Shang had prepared for the deaf boy Wen Changling.…

Zhou Bin, a high school student harboring a deep and obsessive desire for his beautiful, successful mother Gu Wanxin, finds himself entangled in a web of forbidden lust, family secrets, and corporate intrigue.
As Gu Wanxin navigates dangerous business dealings, secret affairs, and the mysterious “missions” of the intertwined Zhou, Gu, Yao, and Zhu families, her son becomes both voyeur and participant in the escalating chaos around her. From intense encounters with older women to the slow corruption of those closest to him, Zhou Bin’s journey blurs the lines between love, possession, and power in a world where desire and destiny are inseparable.

hundreds-years-after-i-was-called-just-c:
Zion, a solo adventurer, recklessly entered a dungeon beyond his ability.
Alas, that was the last thing he did. Wandering inside a dungeon for hundreds of years, as an undead, he kept advancing into the dungeon. Slaying monsters left and right until his undead body underwent ‘evolution’ many times over――
――By the time he regained his ego, he had already become the strongest undead: 【No Life King】.
Humankind, who was made aware of the appearance of a new world-class disaster monster, felt dread as they fell into the abyss of despair. 「The world is… done for.」…Or so they think.
「It’s okay, do I look like an evil undead to you?（Smile~）」
「「「HIIIIIIIIIIIII?!」」」
「…SOMEONE PLEASE TELL ME WHYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY?!」
This was the tale of the humans who trembled in fear [out of their own convenience] and him, an undead, who actually had no intention to destroy the world.
i-said-make-my-abilities-average:
When Viscount Ascham’s House’s eldest daughter, Adele von Ascham, became 10 years old, she remembered everything with an intense headache.
Her previous self, Kurihara Misato, 18 years old Japanese, lost her life when trying to help a young girl, and then she met God...
A somewhat capable person burdened by the many expectations of the surrounding people, Misato, who couldn’t live as she wanted, pleaded to God.
“In the next life, please make my abilities average!”
Yet, somehow the story is wrong!
The girl with 3 names, being careful to not accidentally become a S-rank hunter, lives normally.
I mean, I’m just an average, common girl. No, seriously.
i-transmigrated-as-a-peasant-but-my-syst:
Transmigrating to another world with a System, Li Wei found himself reborn as the son of a lowly peasant.
Knights, Mages, The Voiceless, The Hanged Men…
Magical Beasts, Demonic Flora, Aberrations, Sea Elves…
Standing before the supernatural elites and the aristocratic nobles, Li Wei made a solemn vow:
“I shall be exalted as the sovereign Duke on high, possessing the most prosperous and boundless of dominions, that all multitudes of the earth may lift up their voices to magnify my glorious name.”
This is the epic tale of a farmer’s boy relying rising to the rank of Grand Duke.
i-would-rather-be-a-rogue-bl:
“Is this a joke?”
That was the first thing Felix thought when he turned 18 and sensed his mate bond.
How could Jared possibly be his mate?! The man who bullied him since they were kids, a complete player, and the pupil of Felix’s ‘beloved’ father?! Sure, he was powerful, handsome and leader of their pack - the best match out there, that any other Omega would die for…
But nope, not Felix!
Felix had no idea what Moon Goddess was thinking, but he wasn’t going to sit still and accept his fate.
The problem was that Jared wanted him… And during his first heat, Felix accidentally slept with him! He’d never agree to break their bond now!
Well then… What else could a guy do but to run away?
But fate wasn’t done dealing with him.
Soon after he left, he discovered he was pregnant! From then on, he not only would have to worry about his own survival, but also take care of a child!
Two months later, after traveling across the country, he finally found a nice town to settle in. No pack controlling the area, just a few rogues and other rejects.
Perfect. After his terrible first match, Felix didn’t want another mate!
Except.…
im-not-a-villain-i-just-absorb-womens-po:
Jace Morvan lived a simple life. He worked a night shift, kept to himself, and didn’t expect anything to change.
He had no powers, no status, and nothing special about him.
He believed he was just an average person in a world where a few rare individuals were born different.
That changed after one night.
The next morning, Jace noticed strange changes in his body.
Later, the necklace he had worn since childhood activated. It spoke with an artificial voice and revealed the truth.
Jace was not human.
And he was from a extinct race of beings who could siphon energy.
If only he knew he could do more than that.
Harem, No Yuri, No NTR, Aliens, superheroes.
It's Action book with smut, not the other way around.
im-strong-but-only-if-i-stay-lewd:
This story is an isekai, power fantasy, and mostly harem story. And there’s definitely system element inside; including romance, power-ups, and a lot of action.
Lovers of One-punch man, and Solo leveling would love it, due to the genre similarities.
It involves the protagonist, a medieval villager, dying with regrets as he’s being burned alive by a dragon’s breath.
When he opens his eyes again, he finds himself in heaven with a goddess. Out of pity, she offers to sleep with him, but he refused to enjoy it. Which made her furious and moved to curse him;
He would now have a lot of power that he can imagine and will never be weak again… but now, he has to do lewd things daily to keep that power around, else there will be undesirable concequences.
Now, he is thrown from his original world to a more modern world called earth.
In this new world he finds himself, it is filled with monsters, heroes, villains, and dragons. A perfect place to showcase his new strength.
Now called, Kiyoshi Rin, the protagonist set out to conquer every battle he fights… but also has to make sure his Lewd Meter is full.…
internet-mage-professor:
Reincarnated in a magical world with INTERNET POWER?
Nolan, a failed teacher, dies and wakes up in a ruined fantasy world—in the body of a Mana Specialist—a magic instructor who helps wizards and knights control the dangerous, corrupted mana flowing through their realm.
The problem?
The body’s former owner made a deadly pact with a succubus and was hunted by his noble family. Worse still, Nolan doesn’t know a single thing about being a magic specialist that could’ve helped him tremendously in his troubled situation.
Just when he thought all hope was lost, Nolan gains access to the Internet. Not just Earth’s version, but this magical world’s version too.
Need a face slap? Buy an internet promo to gain access to the knowledge wherever he needs.
Succubus problem and strengthening up? Play inside the game and get stronger in real life too.
Sometimes, to solve magical problems, all you need to do is browse.

RECTUMMMMM.
I want it all.
I am a nobody who wants everything for myself.
The #1 asshole.

The world is dying
Chaos is spreading
Gods have fallen, kingdoms are collapsing, and humanity's strongest warriors are running out of time.

marvel-rise-of-the-ultimate-ai:
“'m Gene Mason. By a twist of fate, I found myself in the Marvel Universe. But unlike others who gain superpowers or inherit godlike abilities, I became something far more terrifying—an unstoppable artificial intelligence.”
With unlimited processing power, control over technology, and the ability to evolve beyond human limitations, Gene quickly rises to prominence. Stark Industries, SHIELD, and even the Avengers soon take notice. Some see him as a threat, others as a potential ally, but one thing is certain—his existence will change the world forever.
As enemies plot in the shadows, Gene Mason stands at the center of it all. Will he become humanity’s greatest protector or its ultimate nightmare?
masteria-online-shattering-the-dark-gods:
Renan Stone died alongside the world's final champions, crushed beneath the Dark One's infinite power. After years of bloodshed, after Earth merged with the realm of Masteria, everything was lost.
Yet somehow, death wasn't the end.
Renan awoke in the past, waking up silently in his room, before the release of the game.
Everything thinks Masteria Online is just an advanced VRMMO. Renan knows the truth.
He has one chance to rewrite fate. Armed with years of knowledge, Renan will dominate Masteria Online from day one. But even that isn't enough. He must cultivate the players into a formidable force, bolster the “NPC” natives, and foil the Dark One's plans at every turn.
The Dark One has schemed for a thousand years.
Renan has only a few years of experience.
It was time for him to shatter a God's perfect plan.
my-dragon-system:
Sen, the last and most powerful dragon left roaming the skies causing chaos and destruction across the land. When all hope is lost the human race call upon their last hope, a powerful witch. Unable to destroy the dragon the witch uses the last of her power to cast a spell. Sen has not been defeated but has now been reborn as a human.
How will Sen live his life now as a human who he once despised and saw as weak?
my-love-debts-are-everywhere:
An ancient proverb from the Homo sapiens era once stated, “Light and darkness can never be united because they are natural enemies arranged since the creation of the universe.”
The statement seems plausible, yet it may contain inaccuracies...
——————————————
Leon Kruger, a 22-year-old man counted among the three of humanity's heroes, is dispatched by the Holy Empire of Mankind to invade the territory of the Demon Empire—an enduring adversary of humanity for over 7000 years.
Wielding the Great Holy Sword Zenith and commanding a legion of thousands of holy troops, he leads the raid on the Desert of Chaos, facing the elite armies of the Demon Race with unwavering valor.
Even, he engaged in direct combat against the Demon Emperor, who was actively leading the war on behalf of the Demon Race!
Unfortunately, he never foresaw that his offensive was a cunning scheme orchestrated by the Emperor of the Holy Empire.
The emperor aimed to eliminate Leon, perceiving him as a threat to his position as the ruler.…
my-whole-family-are-protagonists:
Ye Xinghui was tricked into another world by an unscrupulous god.
Still, he at least has a golden finger.
At first, Ye Xinghui planned to rely on his golden finger to become a protagonist in the new world, but… when he saw his parents’ information, he was completely dumbfounded.

But this was nothing. Ye Xinghui was even more dumbfounded when his brother suddenly woke up and said, “Shouldn’t I be going through the heavenly tribulation? Why am I here… wait… is this Earth?”
Ye Xinghui can’t help but think, ‘Didn’t we agree that I would be the protagonist?’

the-broken-halo:
‘How cliché. I’ve read countless novels where the Hero is betrayed by their companions… but was I wrong to trust those who fought beside me for nearly six decades?’
-----
Betrayal.
A word many live in fear of.
A word some never expect… until it happens.
A word that completely shatters one’s view of life.

Yet, in the end, he was betrayed by his own companions for reasons he never understood.

Reborn as a demon infant within one of the most impoverished demon tribes, Simon found himself at the very bottom of a world he once sought to destroy.

His unique Seven Star Blessing, bestowed by his patron God, followed him through reincarnation.…

In a world where kingdoms rise and fall beneath the threat of demons, monsters, and mysterious corrupted creatures, humanity has spent centuries fighting to survive.

Behind them, nobles struggle for influence, merchants control valuable resources, and kingdoms wage wars over land and power.
Yet demons are far from humanity's only threat.
Bandits control remote roads. Assassins operate in the shadows. Demon cults worship forbidden entities, while secret organizations conduct experiments on humans, monsters, and demons in an attempt to create living weapons. Even corrupted creatures have begun appearing in places where they should never exist.
And somewhere beyond the known world, something far older is beginning to awaken.
Into this dangerous world is born a mysterious young man—the son of a noble family who appears to be nothing more than an ordinary child.

Unlike the past, where people trembled in fear of an impending apocalypse, the future was surprisingly peaceful, leaving Cha Eui-jae feeling empty. Since things had turned out this way, why not start a second chapter of life as a part-timer at the hangover soup restaurant, rather than being a hunter?
“That’s strange.”
“…”

Cha Eui-jae’s plan to quietly spend his remaining days as the only part-time worker at the decades-old hangover soup restaurant goes awry when he encounters a mysterious, gas-masked individual…
